component.name: Fast Screen Off
快速熄屏
component.summary: Turn off your displays with one click

description.p: Fast Screen Off requests display power-off in X11 and supported Wayland sessions. It supports GNOME, KDE Plasma, and compositors implementing the Wayland output-power-management protocol, such as Treeland.
The application does not suspend your computer or change idle timers. Display power management depends on your desktop and graphics driver.
